integrity: Proof is self-contained and uses exact matrix identities, Schur stability, an elementary monotonicity argument, and a rank-one limit. Finite checker instances are supplementary, not exhaustive.
limitations: Classical interpolation-based AB2 under a fixed alternating pair of positive physical step sizes on one scalar real-negative test eigenvalue; no general complex matrix or nonlinear guarantee.
Asymptotic rate uses spectral radius per pair; transient uses the stored-solution two-vector Euclidean norm. No accuracy optimization.
Full text inaccessible for three plausible historical variable-step multistep stability papers; historical equivalence remains possible.
title: Exact periodic CFL, optimal damping, and transient growth for alternating Adams–Bashforth two
